translations./garage/heading: Get RO-1 Back on Its Wheels
translations./garage/brief: The repair stand restored only basic motion. Choose tires, then observe how commands, acceleration, and braking become physical movement.
translations./prediction/heading: What happens when you release power?
translations./prediction/hint: Predict first, then observe how RO-1 slows as it reaches the exit.
translations./prediction/choices/0/feedback: Both the wheel and the chassis have inertia; speed will take some time to drop to zero.
translations./prediction/choices/1/feedback: Record that prediction. During the run, watch when RO-1 begins to slow and how each tire changes braking.
translations./running/normal_line: RO-1: Drive chain online, calibrating acceleration and steering.
translations./debrief/success_summary: RO-1 leaves the repair stand under its own power for the first time.
translations./debrief/failure_summary: Review the motion record, adjust the tires or driving preference, and try again.
translations./debrief/evidence_caption: Speed changes come from motor commands, acceleration limits, and braking capability.
